Files downloaded from the pinned upstream commit.
Local dr_mp3.h patch: read APE tag length from bytes 12..15, include the
optional header once, bound footer seeks, and preserve the buffered stream cursor
after Xing/Info parsing. Preserves final MP3 audio frames with or without seeking.
Format reference: https://mutagen-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/apev2/apev2.html
No audio assets are included.
